items.title: 63475_Arnett Cobb oral history interview
items.q: The transcript mentions 'George Wein' only in a note/label. The interviewee's spoken text discusses John Williams and being the 'star of the show' in Nice, but does not mention George Wein or any interaction with him.

ctx.x: John Williams comes to Nice and tells everybody, said, 'This man come all the way from Texas and broke it up.' I said, 'Broke what up?' He said, 'Man, you was the star of the show.' I said, 'I wasn't.'
